product_family: AI-powered landing page builder and conversion optimization platform

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type I
certifications.proof_quote: Instapage has undergone two types of SOC 2 audits and received certification showing that Instapage has the right security systems that ensure the security, availability, processing integrity, confidentiality, and privacy of customer data.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type II
certifications.proof_quote: Instapage has undergone two types of SOC 2 audits and received certification showing that Instapage has the right security systems that ensure the security, availability, processing integrity, confidentiality, and privacy of customer data.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of a formal ISO 27001 certification. The security page states: 'All our policies align with ISO 27001/2 and NIST 800-53 frameworks, reviewed yearly or after significant changes.' Policy alignment is not equivalent to ISO 27001 certification.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Instapage complies with GDPR data privacy and security standards giving EU customers more control over their shared data.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: A Business Associate Agreement (BAA) template exists at legal.instapage.com/baa (updated December 2025), but third-party analysis as of 2025 reports 'Instapage will not sign a business associate agreement and, therefore, is not HIPAA compliant.' Instapage's own BAA page describes obligations but it is unclear whether Instapage actively executes BAAs for customers. Treat as unverified; verify directly with Instapage before any healthcare use.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of PCI DSS compliance or certification found on vendor domain.

certifications.name: FedRAMP
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of FedRAMP authorization found on vendor domain.

certifications.name: CCPA/CPRA
certifications.proof_quote: Instapage follows the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA), now updated by the California Privacy Rights Act (CPRA), to enhance the protection of personal data and privacy for California residents.

certifications.name: EU-US Data Privacy Framework (DPF)
certifications.proof_quote: self-certified under the EU-US Data Protection Framework (DPF), the Swiss-U.S. DPF, and the UK extension to the EU-US DPF

certifications.name: ISO 42001 (AI Management)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO/IEC 42001 certification or CSA STAR AI certification found on vendor domain.

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of CSA STAR certification found on vendor domain.

privacy.ai_training_note: Instapage's Privacy Notice explicitly discloses use of customer data for AI model training: 'analyzing how our Services are used...including training our artificial intelligence (AI) models; assessing certain content you send or display through our Services.' No public opt-out mechanism for AI training was identified in the privacy policy or terms of service.
privacy.data_region: United States (primary). Data processing and storage occur in the US. EU/EEA customers are subject to cross-border data transfers governed by EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) and the EU-US Data Privacy Framework. The privacy notice states: 'your personal information will be transferred to us, our affiliates, and our subprocessors in the United States.'

security.name: Encryption in transit
security.value: TLS/SSL encryption for all user interactions. SSL certificates verify website authenticity and encrypted connections.

security.name: Encryption at rest
security.value: Full disk encryption and browser session encryption confirmed.

security.name: Infrastructure
security.value: Dual cloud redundancy across Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). 99.99% server uptime guarantee. Global data centers in North America, Europe, and Asia.

security.name: Single Sign-On (SSO)
security.value: SAML 2.0 enterprise SSO supported (Okta, PingOne, OneLogin, Microsoft Azure, Google GSuite). Available on Convert (enterprise) plan only.

security.name: Vulnerability management
security.value: Quarterly vulnerability assessments, annual internal and external penetration testing, monthly network scans.

security.name: Intrusion detection
security.value: Network safeguards including intrusion detection and host-based anti-virus.

security.name: DPA / SCCs
security.value: Data Processing Agreement (DPA) available with EU SCCs (Module Two for Controller-Processor), UK IDTA, and Swiss SCCs incorporated.

security.name: Audit logs
security.value: Audit logs available on enterprise (Convert) plan.

security.name: Bug Bounty Program
security.value: Bug Bounty Program listed in site footer and linked from the home page.

products.name: Create
products.data_scope: $99/month, 15,000 monthly visitors. Unlimited pages and conversions. Basic SSL, GDPR compliance features, Google SSO.
products.notes: Entry plan; no enterprise SSO or audit logs. SAML SSO not included.

products.name: Optimize
products.category: Landing page builder with CRO (mid tier)
products.data_scope: $199/month, 30,000 monthly visitors. Includes A/B testing, AI experiments, analytics, heatmaps.
products.notes: Recommended plan. Adds experimentation features; no enterprise SSO or audit logs.

products.name: Convert
products.data_scope: Custom pricing. Unlimited visitors. Includes all Optimize features plus enterprise SSO (SAML 2.0), audit logs, guaranteed uptime SLA, direct lead bypass to CRM.
products.notes: Only tier with enterprise security controls (SSO, audit logs, SLA). Best fit for regulated or compliance-conscious organizations.

compare.pricing_model: Subscription (monthly/annual), tiered by visitor volume. Create $99/mo, Optimize $199/mo, Convert custom.
compare.data_residency: United States only. No EU data residency option found. Cross-border transfers rely on SCCs and EU-US DPF.

flags: Instapage explicitly discloses training AI models on customer data, including content customers send or display through the service, and no public opt-out mechanism was identified. Review carefully before sensitive use cases.
The security page claims policy alignment with ISO 27001/2, but no formal certification evidence was found; this reflects framework alignment, not certification.

A BAA template exists in the Legal Hub (updated December 2025), but third-party healthcare compliance research (2025) states Instapage does not sign BAAs. HIPAA status is unresolved; verify directly with Instapage before any PHI or healthcare use.
All data is processed and stored in the United States. EU customers relying on data residency in Europe cannot use Instapage for that requirement.
SOC 2 Type I was obtained in November 2019 and Type II as of May 2020; public pages do not specify the most recent audit renewal date.
